Yocto/GL: Volumetric Path Tracing - GitHub
As stated in the project title, we deal with volumetric path tracing (VPT) for heterogenous materials since it's not currently supported by the actual release of Yocto/GL. In particular, we focus our implementation on heterogeneous materials, adding full support for volumetric textures and OpenVDB models. Next, we proceed with the implementation of delta tracking algorithm presented in PBRT ...
